content.text:
The build passes. 

I extended the business-day rule in `OwnerRestControllerV1.resolveRegistrationDate` to skip public holidays in addition to weekends:

- Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` constant holding the five fixed dates (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28).
- The roll-forward loop now also advances one day at a time whenever the date lands on a listed holiday, so the adjusted `registrationDate` is always a non-holiday weekday. This handles chained cases too (e.g. 2026-12-25 → skips the holiday and the following weekend → 2026-12-28 is also a holiday → rolls to 2026-12-29).

Every value derived from the registration date (membership number year segment, per-day limit, bulk-signup warning) continues to use the adjusted date since the loop mutates the value written back onto the payload. The test suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test passing).
